PAHAYAG NG LOKAL NA PAMAHALAAN NG QUEZON CITY

Ang RESQC Bag o emergency go bag ay unang ipinamahagi noong Hulyo sa mga residente na nakatira sa mga waterways, creeks, at ilog na madalas ilikas, gayundin sa mga biktima ng sunog. Ang susunod na makatatanggap nito ay ang mga low-income households na tinatawiran ng West Valley Fault sa siyam na barangay, at may bantang masira o gumuho ang kanilang kabahayan base sa hazard maps at risk profile na ginawa ng mga eksperto. 

Prayoridad ng lokal na pamahalaan na unang mabigyan ang mga pinakalantad sa panganib.

Mas epektibo ang emergency go bag kapag ito ay binuo ng bawat pamilya base sa kanilang pangangailangan at kakayahan bilang paghahanda sa anumang sakuna. Narito ang halimbawa:

https://t.co/Uw1Bjy1uWQ

Kung may emergency sa inyong lugar, tumawag lamang sa Helpline 122.

Maraming salamat po sa inyong pang-unawa at patuloy na pakikiisa sa ating mga programang pangkaligtasan.

Happy Employees’ Day, QC! 🎉

Masayang ipinagdiwang ng Pamahalaang Lungsod ng Quezon ang Employees’ Day bilang bahagi ng ika-86 founding anniversary ng QC.

Iba't ibang aktibidad, papremyo, at sorpresa ang inihandog ng QC Government bilang pasasalamat sa dedikasyon at serbisyo ng mga kawani.

Pinangunahan ni Mayor Joy Belmonte ang awarding ceremony para sa mga nagwagi sa raffle at dance competition.

Nakamit ng Office of the City Assessor ang championship, habang 1st runner up ang Traffic and Transport Management Department, habang 2nd runner up ang QC Anti-Drug Abuse Advisory Council at Office of the Vice Mayor.

Marine Electricals Ltd  | FY25 Investor Presentation Highlights & Key Rerating Triggers

1️⃣ Integrated Electrification Powerhouse
✦  Diversified presence across Defence, Industrial, VTMS & EV Charging.
✦  Operating since 1978 – India’s pioneer in electrical & automation systems.
✦  8 manufacturing plants (Goa, Mumbai, UAE, Italy) + 14 service centres across India.

2️⃣  Defence & Marine Leadership
✦  ~50% market share in electrical systems for Indian Navy & Coast Guard.
✦  Supplies to Scorpène submarines, INS Vikrant, Project 17A & P15B vessels.
✦  Expanding into battery propulsion, IPMS, radars & remote service systems.
✦  High entry barriers – vendor qualification requires prior naval experience.

3️⃣  Industrial Solutions & Data Centres
✦  Among India’s largest LV & MV switchgear manufacturers.
✦  Exclusive partner for Schneider Blokset panels.
✦  Major clients: Adani Connex, STT, Bridge DC, Netmagic, PDG, Equinix.
✦  Moving up the value chain to full Turnkey EMS + IBMS solutions.

4️⃣ EV Charging Ecosystem – Let’s Bijlify India
✦  End-to-end control: hardware + software + app (Bijlify).
✦  3.3 kW–240 kW chargers for commercial, residential & public infra.
✦  Rolling out PMC-based city partnerships – annuity-style recurring revenue.
✦  Early mover in mandated EV infra for residential & commercial complexes.

5️⃣  Global Foray via VTMS
✦  Acquired Xanatos Marine (Canada) – global leader in Vessel Traffic Mgmt Systems.
✦  Executed projects in Philippines; bidding across Africa, Asia & Europe.
✦  Positioned to capture India’s port digitisation wave, as VTMS becomes mandatory for all ports.

6️⃣  Strategic Growth Flywheels
✦  R&D focus on battery propulsion, marine radar, and automation solutions.
✦  Scaling manufacturing & IP base to support new-age electrification.
✦  Cross-vertical leverage across Defence + Industry + EV + Ports = durable compounding.

7⃣  Key Rerating Triggers Ahead
✦  Defence tech upgrades + naval radar systems = margin accretive.
✦  Data centre & infra electrification = steady volume growth.
✦  EV charging ecosystem = new annuity vertical.
✦  VTMS global expansion = high visibility export story.

🧭 Investor Compass View
▪️Transforming from a naval-grade systems maker to a smart electrification platform.
▪️Expanding across Defence, Industry, EV, and Global VTMS segments.
▪️FY26-28 poised for multi-vertical rerating led by:
  • Defence tech upgrades & radar systems
  • Data Centre & Industrial automation scale-up
  • EV charging ecosystem monetisation
  • Global VTMS export expansion

No Buy/Sell recommendation
#StocksInFocus #StocksToWatch #marineelectricals #marineelectrical
